name: Munitions Generation (Sp)
body:
Prerequisite: Level 4

Effect: The companion can spontaneously replicate ammunition provided to it. As long as the companion has at least 1 piece of ammunition integrated into it, the companion can generate more ammunition, as if benefiting from an abundant ammunition spell. While this can duplicate magic ammunition, it does not copy the ammunition’s magical properties (only its material properties, if any).

Resonance: Allies within 30 feet generate their own ammunition, enhancing their ammunition containers by an abundant ammunition spell. This resonance lasts for 1 minute.
